recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-45266 in core source; preserve the later FHIR-55241 unknown concept unless that separate decision is reopened.
issue_request: FHIR-45266 was an Applied/Persuasive Imaging Integration change request for R6 asking the ImagingSelection 2D Graphic Type value set and bound regionType display to align with DICOM SCOORD by replacing interpolated with multipoint, correcting the polyline definition, fixing the value set title spacing, and pointing comments at DICOM PS 3.3 C.18.6.
initial_application: Commit a4ba8ded88f9c692ede7f533fd0bd6f7df457ff0 applied FHIR-45266 on 2024-07-30 by changing source/imagingselection/codesystem-imagingselection-2dgraphictype.xml from interpolated to multipoint, updating the polyline definition, updating source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml short/comment text, and correcting the ValueSet title in source/imagingselection/valueset-imagingselection-2dgraphictype.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists imagingselection as a current resource owned by II at FMM 6, so the inspected source is in build scope. Later Applied issue FHIR-55241 deliberately added an unknown escape-valve concept to the same 2D graphic type code system and short display, so the current six-code expansion should not be reverted to FHIR-45266's original five-code resolution table. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion; Confluence only records that FHIR-45266 was discussed at the 2024-05 Imaging Integration WGM.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The current code system contains point, multipoint, polyline, circle, ellipse, and the later approved unknown concept; interpolated is absent; the bound regionType short display names multipoint instead of interpolated; and the DICOM comment points to PS 3.3 C.18.6.1.2.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue added the approved unknown escape-valve concept to ImagingSelection.instance.imageRegion2D.regionType, explaining why current source has six concepts rather than the five in FHIR-45266's resolution table.
